newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock funds post redemptions for 2 days.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock funds post redemptions for 2 days.

text.p: U.S. equity funds suffered industrywide redemptions of $306 million for the two days ended May 19 compared with redemptions of $784 million for the three days ended May 15, according to estimates by Mutual Fund Trim Tabs.

The fund tracking firm said aggressive growth funds posted redemptions of $364 million compared with outflows of $759 million, while growth funds had outflows of $291 million versus outflows of $555 million.
International funds had redemptions of $516 million versus inflows of $396 million.

Bond funds had inflows of $339 million versus inflows of $292 million. High yield funds had inflows of $144 million versus inflows of $147 million; corporate/income/global funds had inflows of $172 million versus inflows of $137 million. Muni funds had inflows of $50 million versus outflows of $142 million.
